BIOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri.

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Specimen Collection and Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Specimen Collection and Preservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Specimen Collection and Preservation.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutrition? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutrition.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutrition.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutrition.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutrition.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation 1.4 Chemicals of life 2.0 Anatomy and Physiolo.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Chemicals of Life? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Chemicals of Life.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Chemicals of Life.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Chemicals of Life.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Chemicals of Life.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Gaseous Exchange and Respiration? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Gaseous Exchange and Respiration.

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell Structure and Specialisation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell Structure and Specialisation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell Structure and Specialisation.

13. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transport? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transport.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transport.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transport.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transport.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Biology 1.2 Specimen Collection and Preservation 1.3 Cell Struct.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Gaseous Exchange and Respiration 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Nutri and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Gaseous Exchange and Respiration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition 3.2 Transport 3.3 Gaseous Exchange and Respiration Total Number of Les and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Nutrition and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Transport and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
